theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+0.96%) and Financials (+0.78%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-0.97%) and Communication Svcs (-0.69%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.29%, defensives -0.14%, and value/cyclicals +0.16% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.16%, Dow +0.23%, Nasdaq -0.02% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.15%. The VIX fell 0.69% to 17.39, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.09% to $4,052.60, crude oil was little changed at $102.79, and bitcoin slipped 0.16% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
